summary: Iteration 19 regression: ALL 5 FIXES VERIFIED. Backend pytest 12/12 passed (100%). Frontend Playwright confirmed owner-authority input visible/writable. System stable and safe to proceed to Phase 2.

FIX1_CRITICAL_registration_zip_alias.evidence: Both /api/documents/bundle/{tenant_id} and /api/registration/zip/{tenant_id} return 200 with application/zip. ZIP contents identical (same namelist). Contains 02_Registrazione/registrazione.txt and 05_Ospitalita/comunicazione_ospitalita.pdf folders. 404 returned for missing tenant_id.

FIX2_HIGH_landlord_authority.evidence: POST /api/landlords with authority='Comune di Padova' persists field; GET returns it. PUT updates authority to 'Questura di Padova' successfully. Field is optional (omitting it works). Frontend: Login → Proprietari → Aggiungi → [data-testid='owner-authority'] is visible, editable, accepts 'Comune di Padova' (label 'Autorità Emittente').

FIX3_MEDIUM_tenant_ocr_address_mapping.evidence: OcrScanner.js line 83-84 confirmed: onDataExtracted payload includes both residence AND address=result.residence. Backend issuing_authority field accepted on TenantCreate; persisted via POST and retrievable via GET.

FIX4_MEDIUM_cascade_delete.evidence: DELETE /api/tenants/{id} cascade-deletes hospitality_records and monthly_status (verified via tenants.py line 158-159: db.hospitality_records.delete_many + db.monthly_status.delete_many). After deletion, GET /api/hospitality/records no longer contains tenant_id, and GET /api/hospitality/pdf/{tenant_id} returns 404.

FIX5_MEDIUM_hospitality_pdf_padova_fallb.evidence: With empty property_comune AND empty host_residence, generated PDF text (extracted via pypdf) contains 'Luogo e data: Padova, DD/MM/YYYY'. The malformed pattern 'Luogo e data: ,' is NOT present. hospitality_pdf.py line 288: `luogo = (luogo_raw.strip().title() if luogo_raw else '') or 'Padova'`.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} — accessibility a11y warning, non-blocking

action_items: (LOW PRIORITY) Add aria-describedby or Description to Landlord New/Edit DialogContent to silence Radix-UI a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: registration.py: stacked decorator pattern (@router.get with two paths) is correctly used for the alias — clean.

tenants.py delete_tenant cascade: only deletes hospitality_records and monthly_status. Consider also cascading orphaned payments, invoices, contracts, and documents owned by tenant_id (currently they linger in DB after tenant deletion). Not blocking iter19, but worth tracking.

schemas.py LandlordCreate: only stores 'full_name' (no surname/name fields server-side); frontend Landlords.js uses surname+name composite. This is fine as long as the form composes full_name correctly before POST.
hospitality_pdf.py luogo fallback to 'Padova' is hard-coded — acceptable for current Padova-focused tenancy but should be made configurable if scaling to other cities.
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient TEST_-prefixed landlords/properties/tenants and clean them up via DELETE in finally blocks. No persistent seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 iter18 fixes (FIX1 zip alias, FIX2 landlord authority, FIX3 OCR address mapping, FIX4 cascade delete, FIX5 Padova PDF fallback) are verified working. Phase 2 features can now be safely added. Reusable helpers in test_iteration19.py: _create_landlord/_create_property/_create_tenant — note property requires number_of_rooms+capacity+rental_amount; tenant requires passport_issue_date+passport_expiry_date.
